_comment: Element ids observed from REAL mermaid@11 (the version src/render.mjs's CDN tag
pins), rendering the `source` below in headless Chrome on 2026-07-30. Recorded
because the checks previously hand-wrote `id="flowchart-A-12"` -- a shape
mermaid does not emit -- which let the entire diagram gesture ship dead: the
click walk-up, the pin-candidate scan and the hover/cursor CSS all keyed off a
`^flowchart-` prefix that never matched, in a browser, ever.
The point is the PREFIX: mermaid 11 namespaces every node id with the diagram's
own generated svg id. Any check that mocks mermaid must reproduce that shape, or
it is testing a diagram renderer that does not exist.
To re-record: render `source` in a browser and read back the g.node ids.
